body:
# Callisto

Low ranged defence - guide is RANGED (not the data MAGIC). Webweaver/Craw's bow carry the Wilderness bonus.

reviewedReferenceSections.label: Transportation
reviewedReferenceSections.sourceWikitext:
{{Map|3292,3849,desc:Entrance to Callisto's Den|mtype=pin|align=right|caption=Entrance to Callisto's Den}}
*With 90 [[Magic]], players on the [[Ancient spellbook]] can use [[Annakarl Teleport]], which will teleport them into the [[Demonic Ruins]]. Simply go south of your location after arriving. Be wary of [[PK'ers]] upon arrival. This is the fastest way to reach Callisto. 
**Alternatives to this also include the [[Annakarl teleport (tablet)|Annakarl teleport]] tablet and a portal attuned to Annakarl. Be wary of PK'ers on arrival; if using the house portal, you should have a [[scrying pool]] to check the area first.
*With 57 [[Woodcutting]], players can make a [[Waka canoe]] and use it to go to the [[Wilderness]]. Go north-east of your location, but be wary of PKers.
** Having a [[royal seed pod]] makes this strategy more effective as this teleport takes the player close to a [[gnome glider]] which they can then take to [[Al Kharid]] (specified as [[Kar-Hewo]] on the destinations menu) and then walk to the canoe station past the Al Kharid toll gate. This means that the royal seed pod can be used as a lv 30 Wilderness teleport, as a banking tool, and as a way to reach Callisto.
*If you have neither of these requirements, simply use the [[games necklace]] to teleport to the [[Corporeal Beast]]'s lair, exit the cave then run up north. Be wary of PKers and the [[poison spider]]s if you do not plan to hug the lava river.
* Players who have completed the Hard or Elite [[Wilderness Diary]] can use the [[Wilderness Sword 4|Wilderness Sword]] to teleport to the [[Fountain of Rune]] and run south-west to Callisto.

reviewedReferenceSections.label: Setups
reviewedReferenceSections.sourceWikitext:
Callisto can deal incredibly high melee damage through prayer, so melee combat is not advised. Callisto is no longer immune to magic damage but has a high magic level, so ranged is the ideal method for doing damage. However, the boss will approach targets constantly, so a method of freezing the boss in place is strongly recommended outside of the largest of groups. Spells such as [[Ice Barrage]] or [[Entangle]] are commonly used. Spells such as [[Vulnerability]], (especially when combined with the [[tome of water]] effect), or even a dragon warhammer are sometimes also used to lower its defence.  A charged [[Webweaver bow]] has a powerful bonus against Wilderness monsters and can provide the fastest kills, but it carries higher risk compared to other setups. Players (especially [[Ironman mode|Ironmen]]) who do not have access to the above weapons commonly use a rune crossbow with broad or [[Ruby bolts (e)]] in a group for effective damage.
<tabber>
Ranged=
[[Callisto]] has very low defence against ranged, and is particularly dangerous when up close. The ideal setup is 3-4 items to maximize ranged strength and accuracy, along with [[magical]] defence and tank equipment, such as a [[Dinh's bulwark]], for [[PK'ers]]. In a team, consider having 1 group member equipped with a charged [[tome of water]] and runes to cast [[vulnerability]] to reduce Callisto's defence by 15% on a successful hit, increasing the group's DPS by around 5-7% depending on gear.

reviewedReferenceSections.label: Attacks
reviewedReferenceSections.sourceWikitext:
[[File:Fighting Callisto.png|thumb|300px|A group of players fighting Callisto.]]

*Melee: Callisto swipes at the player. This has AoE capabilities and deals massive damage; using [[Protect from Melee]] reduces the damage by ~50%. This attack is extremely accurate and has a maximum hit of 55, with a minimum of 35. It has AoE capabilities, damaging anyone else near his main target and he can also attack diagonally across.
*Ranged: Callisto launches crescent-shaped projectiles at everyone in the den if he cannot attack with melee. This has a maximum hit of 31 and can be fully blocked with prayer.
*Knockback: Callisto will launch a white orb-like projectile at a targeted player, which will send them flying backwards and inflict damage if [[Protect from Magic]] is not activated when the attack visually hits the player.
** The knockback attack is a single-target attack with splash AOE. This means that it will only target one player, but the spell will affect all players within a 3x3 square of the targeted player when it hits.
** The damage the player will take from this attack when it hits them off prayer depends on how far the player can be knocked back before they hit an object (the walls of the arena or any bear traps on the floor). The attack will attempt to knock the player back 3 tiles. If the player can be knocked back the full 3 tiles without hitting an object, they will take 5 damage. This scales up by 15 damage for each tile of knockback that cannot be completed, so the player will take 20 damage if they were 2 tiles away from an object they were pushed into, and 35 damage if they were 1 tile away. If the player is directly next to an object that the attack pushes them into, they will take 50 damage.
*Bear Traps: At 66% health, Callisto will deploy red, ghostly-like bear traps around the arena. Getting caught in a trap will deal up to 15 damage and briefly bind the player. The traps will be redeployed again at ~33% health and appear afterwards with every attack he makes.

reviewedReferenceSections.label: Strategy
reviewedReferenceSections.sourceWikitext:
Callisto will spawn to the south of the den, right in front of the exit leading into the Escape Caves. If you wish to avoid [[player killer]]s, it is recommended to place a secondary account waiting outside the entrance to scout potential threats. All players who enter the den will spawn to the north, similar to Venenatis' lair. 

Callisto uses highly damaging melee attacks and is weakest to ranged attacks. Due to hitting much harder, players are recommended to range him. The first immobilizing spell (such as ice barrage) will always land if he is not already frozen, and the attacking player has equipment with a total Magic accuracy greater than or equal to 0. Binds past the first are not guaranteed to hit.

If he cannot attack with melee, he will begin using a much weaker ranged attack until he can reach his target. Callisto will occasionally launch a white orb at his target, of which they should switch on Protect from Magic or risk taking up to 50 damage from the attack.

Upon reaching 66 and 33% of his health, Callisto will roar, launching bear traps all across the arena. Stepping on one will deal up to 15 damage and bind the player for a few seconds. The traps will linger around for a short duration before expiring, but will immediately be replaced with a fresh set of traps. While roaring, he will also glow red, breaking free of binds in the process and requiring a player to refreeze him.

If bringing low risk items, it is recommended that rather than trying to leave via the Escape Caves to rebank, the player instead [[death|suicide]] to Callisto, as they will be able to reclaim items for free as apart from the rares (which should be covered via [[Protect Item]]) none of the drops are individually over 100,000 coins. The player will lose untradeable items such as [[looting bag]]s however.

Artio will spawn to the south of the den, right in front of the exit. If you wish to avoid [[player killer]]s, it is recommended to place a secondary account waiting outside the entrance to scout potential threats. All players who enter the den will spawn to the north, similar to Callisto's lair. 

Artio uses highly damaging melee attacks and is weakest to magic and ranged attacks. Ice spells will land often even with minimal magic gear, binding her temporarily. If she cannot attack with melee, she will begin using a much weaker ranged attack until she can reach her target. Artio will occasionally launch a white orb at her target, which should be protected against by switching on Protect from Magic or risk taking up to 50 damage from the attack.

reviewedReferenceSections.label: Setups
reviewedReferenceSections.sourceWikitext:
'''Note''': As Artio is in the Wilderness in an area that is active with PKers, ensure valuables are kept protected, and check items screens for kept on death equipment—you may lose untradeables here if [[trouver parchment]] is not used on them. The best way is to not take anything into the Wilderness you are not willing to lose. The [[Skull_(status)#Skull prevention|PK skull prevention]] option is highly recommended for added security.

Artio can deal incredibly high melee damage through prayer, so melee combat is not advised. She is not immune to magic damage, so [[Stun (status)#Spells|binding]] her in place is strongly recommended. [[Ice spells]], such as [[Ice Barrage]] or [[Ice Blitz]], are commonly used. They are also guaranteed to hit Artio while she is not frozen, if the player has 0 or higher magic accuracy bonus. Players can use either ranged or magic after freezing the boss. One method involves using [[Protect from Melee]] and healing with [[Bloodbark armour]] and [[Blood Barrage]].  Players with high Magic and Defence levels will find they are able to heal more with Blood Barrage than Artio can damage them with melee, making this a very low-effort method, only requiring occasional eating and prayer restoration.
<tabber>
Ranged=
[[Webweaver]] is the strongest weapon against Artio. Ideally you want to maximize range damage, while keeping your magic attack bonus at 0 or higher to allow for guaranteed freezes on Artio. Gear like [[bloodbark boots]], [[barrows gloves]], [[imbued god capes]], [[god books]] and [[ring of shadows]] are good to keep your magic bonus high enough, without sacrificing much range dps or incurring high risk. Defence bonus -- particularly magic defence -- is also beneficial for tanking [[PKers]].

Artio is significantly vulnerable to Magic. However, compared to Ranged, a Magic setup typically results in lesser defences which leaves the player more vulnerable to PKers.

It can be difficult to survive PKers if using magic equipment. Therefore, swapping out a protected item for [[Dinh's bulwark]] can aid in survivability; the player can simply switch to Dinh's if under attack.
